PUBLIC INFORMATION

The public may address the members of the City Council on any matters within the
jurisdiction of the City Council or on any items on the agenda of the City Council
during the designated public comment periods. There will be two Oral
Communication sessions: one for Agendized Items (comment about items ON the
agenda) and the other for non-Agendized items (comment about items NOT on the
Agenda). The Oral Communications portion of the agenda is limited to a duration of
one hour unless otherwise approved by the City Council. Comment time is normally
3 minutes depending on the number of speakers.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR MATTERS LISTED ON THE AGENDA (MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC) (LIMITED TO ONE HOUR) JR brings up that there is a modification of the account numbers 
Moved by Councilmember Hicks and Second by Councilmember Dear

Under discussion- Councilmember Dear wanted clarity on the transfer of the 26 million dollars to the Carson Reclamation Authority. 
What amount of money is CAM Carson giving toward the project?

City Attorney Soltani stated that there have been over seen decades of developers rying to develop this site to no avail. The negotiations have been between CRA and CAM Carson to finish the remedial work needed. The sales tax agreement was discussed to facilitate the agreement of all the work that needs to be completed. So the original sales tax agreement included spending a year and a half they still won't recover. The city relied on an economist and the model and the court has looked into this sales tax agreement as well and a judge from LA County Superior Court validated this agreement that it is legal and the numbers all penciled out. The 26 million dollar agreement, construction costs are higher than they were six years ago, they are back to the table and now they are doing all the utilities and embankments and increased thier cots further. So this 26 million dollar incentive but the reasons behind it was so that the lot would not remain vacant. As part of the deal, they are no longer responsible for handling the city work. Farring is contributing to the road project. The CRA boards finds the CAM Carson more appealing so they were willing to forgive that because of all the othe peoejcts they have been willing to take over. Soltani further explained that this is vry complex and cannot be discussed in psylo
